title: The stable conormal comparison base changed to a prime of the original quotient
statement: Let $k$ be a field, $P=k[x_1,\ldots,x_n]$ and $Q=k[y_1,\ldots,y_m]$ [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring], $I\subseteq P$, $J\subseteq Q$, and $S=P/I$, $T=Q/J$ [def-weil-pbc-algebra-hom-quotient]. Let $\mathfrak q$ be a prime of $S$, $g\in S\setminus\mathfrak q$, $B=S_g$ [def-weil-ring-localization-away], and $e:T\simeq_k B$. Put $R=S_{\mathfrak q}$ [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime], and give $R$ its $T$-algebra structure by $T\xrightarrow e B\to R$, the unique map extending $S\to R$. With the quotient actions on the conormals and module localization [def-weil-pbc-module-localization], there is an $R$-linear isomorphism $(I/I^2)_{\mathfrak q}\oplus R^m\simeq (R\otimes_T J/J^2)\oplus R^n$. Here $R^a$ is the module of functions $\operatorname{Fin}(a)\to R$.

source.place: Algebra, Tag 00S6 (lemma-conormal-module-localize), base changed to the local ring in the last paragraph of Tag 00SC (lemma-lci). Sources read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/00S6 and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/00SC on 2026-10-13.

proof.text: Apply [lem-weil-pbc-conormal-module-principal-localization] to the quotient map α : k[x] → S and β : k[y] → T → S_g. Quotient surjectivity and e give surjectivity. Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ_ker and e.injective identify the kernels with I and J.

Use Extension.cotangentEquivCotangentKer, Ideal.Cotangent.equivOfEq and LinearEquiv.extendScalarsOfSurjective to identify the first extension conormal with I.Cotangent over S. IsLocalizedModule.linearEquiv identifies its localization away from g with S_g tensor_S I.Cotangent. These are direct compositions of Mathlib equivalences and the kernel equality.

The image of g in R=S_q is a unit by IsLocalization.AtPrime.isUnit_to_map_iff, so IsLocalization.Away.lift defines S_g → R. Its lift_comp identity gives the S/S_g/R scalar tower. Base change the comparison to R. The left conormal factor identifies with (I/I²)_q by AlgebraTensorModule.cancelBaseChange and IsLocalizedModule.linearEquiv at q.

Extension.cotangentEquiv identifies the second extension conormal with S_g tensor_Q D.ker. Tensor cancellation and the kernel equality give R tensor_Q J. TensorProduct.quotTensorEquivQuotSMul and quotient-surjective scalar extension identify T tensor_Q J with J.Cotangent. Tensor cancellation then identifies R tensor_T J.Cotangent with R tensor_Q J. Compose these equivalences.

TensorProduct.prodRight and TensorProduct.piScalarRight identify the base changes of products and finite powers. Compose their inverses, the base-changed comparison, and the conormal identifications to obtain (I/I²)_q × R^m ≃ (R tensor_T J/J²) × R^n.

theorem principalLocalization_conormal_atPrime_baseChange
    {k : Type u} [Field k] (n : ℕ) (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin n) k))
    (q : PrimeSpectrum (MvPolynomial (Fin n) k ⧸ I))
    (g : MvPolynomial (Fin n) k ⧸ I) (hg : g ∉ q.asIdeal)
    (m : ℕ) (J : Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k))
    (e : (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k ⧸ J) ≃ₐ[k] Localization.Away g) :
    let φ : (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k ⧸ J) →+* Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal :=
      (IsLocalization.Away.lift g
        ((IsLocalization.AtPrime.isUnit_to_map_iff
          (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal) q.asIdeal g).mpr hg)).comp e.toRingHom
    letI : Algebra (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k ⧸ J) (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal) :=
      φ.toAlgebra
    Nonempty
      ((LocalizedModule q.asIdeal.primeCompl I.Cotangent ×
          (Fin m → Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal)) ≃ₗ[Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal]
        ((Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal ⊗[MvPolynomial (Fin m) k ⧸ J] J.Cotangent) ×
          (Fin n → Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal)))
